claim_text: The January 24, 2024 indictment in United States v. Mohamed et al., No. 0:24-cr-00015 (ECF 1), alleges that from approximately February 2021 through April 2022 Star Distribution LLC, an alleged sham food vendor owned by Suleman Yusuf Mohamed, received approximately $10 million in Federal Child Nutrition Program funds, including more than $4.9 million from Feeding Our Future, $1.6 million from United Youth of Mpls, and $1 million from Inspiring Youth & Outreach. Those components are part of the $10 million, not additional. Face language is received (amount_paid). The $10 million overlaps family site receipts and the >$12 million para 91 figure and must not be added to HSS or to the Bock $250 million charging headline.

supporting_passages.quote: From approximately February 2021 through April 2022, Star Distribution received approximately $10 million in Federal Child Nutrition Program funds, including more than $4.9 million from Feeding Our Future, $1.6 million from United Youth of Mpls, and $1 million from Inspiring Youth & Outreach.

amounts.methodology: Para 80: Star Distribution received approximately $10 million.
Component: more than $4.9 million from Feeding Our Future. Not independent of the $10 million.

qualifiers: do not add $4.9M+$1.6M+$1M on top of $10M
do not add Star $10M to family $12M, HSS, or Bock $250M
